headings: Thank you for considering Golden Earth Studio for your art inquiries. Here are some important details you should be aware of before proceeding: Contact and Sales - We facilitate art sales via email inquiries. To inquire about purchasing a piece of art, please email us goldenearthstudio@outlook.com - By contacting us via email regarding an art piece, you express your interest in purchasing the artwork. Payment - Payment details will be discussed and agreed upon via email correspondence. - We accept payment via methods that we'll communicate through email. Enquiries and Communication - When you inquire about a piece of art, please provide your full name, contact email, and any specific details you'd like to discuss. - We will reply to your email inquiry within a reasonable time frame to discuss details, pricing, and payment arrangements. Returns - Due to the nature of bespoke art works, all sales are considered final and non-returnable. Privacy - We respect your privacy and will use your provided information only for the purpose of art inquiries and transactions. - We do not share your information with third parties and follow applicable privacy laws. Contact For any inquiries, assistance, or to start the purchase process, please email us at goldenearthstudio@outlook.com. Thank you for considering Golden Earth Studio for your art needs.

Terms

Thank you for considering Golden Earth Studio for your art inquiries. Here are some important details you should be aware of before proceeding:

Contact and Sales
- We facilitate art sales via email inquiries. To inquire about purchasing a piece of art, please email us goldenearthstudio@outlook.com
- By contacting us via email regarding an art piece, you express your interest in purchasing the artwork.

Payment
- Payment details will be discussed and agreed upon via email correspondence.
- We accept payment via methods that we'll communicate through email.

Enquiries and Communication
- When you inquire about a piece of art, please provide your full name, contact email, and any specific details you'd like to discuss.
- We will reply to your email inquiry within a reasonable time frame to discuss details, pricing, and payment arrangements.

Returns
- Due to the nature of bespoke art works, all sales are considered final and non-returnable.

Privacy
- We respect your privacy and will use your provided information only for the purpose of art inquiries and transactions.
- We do not share your information with third parties and follow applicable privacy laws.

Contact
For any inquiries, assistance, or to start the purchase process, please email us at goldenearthstudio@outlook.com.
Thank you for considering Golden Earth Studio for your art needs.
